q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE NAME NOT IN (SELECT SP.NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS SP JOIN ORDERS AS ORD JOIN COMPANY AS COM ON SP.SALES_ID = ORD.SALES_ID AND ORD.COM_ID = COM.COM_ID WHERE COM.NAME = 'RED')

The difference arises when there are no orders for the 'RED' company, as Q1 will return all salespersons, while Q2 will return an empty result set.
